module.name: ibm_roks_single_nic
module.description: Provision an IBM ROKS cluster with registry COS and a transit gateway using a minimal operator input set.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to provision cluster resources.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region for the ROKS cluster.

required.name: roks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the IBM ROKS cluster to create.

required.name: workers_per_zone
required.description: Worker node count per availability zone.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used by the deployment. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM credential template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: min_worker_vcpu_count
optional.description: Minimum worker node vCPU count for flavor selection.

optional.name: min_worker_memory_gb
optional.description: Minimum worker node memory in GB for flavor selection.

key_outputs.name: cluster_id
key_outputs.description: Cluster ID alias for managed cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: Cluster name alias for managed cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: openshift_cluster_public_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Cluster API endpoint used for BNK inventory registration.

key_outputs.name: region
key_outputs.description: IBM Cloud region for the cluster.

key_outputs.name: cos_instance_name
key_outputs.description: Derived IBM COS instance name for the local registry.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
